verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes show Windmill serves an llms.txt at its docs root (HTTP 200) and markdown versions of its docs pages (e.g. /docs/intro.md). An agent can therefore be pointed directly at agent-oriented documentation. missing for 10: first-party documentation describing the llms.txt/markdown-docs offering and its scope, independent or community corroboration of agents using it effectively

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
